description: Deliverable inbox writer (libs/core/foundation/deliverable-inbox-writer-capability.ts): libs/core assumes it only to add an operator task to the deliverable inbox (active/shared/inbox/entries.jsonl, libs/core/deliverable-inbox.ts addInboxEntry) on behalf of a caller with no inbox grant: the CD-10 bolt-review rejection (libs/core/mission/mission-bolt-review.ts) and the CD-11 operator hand-off / manual reminder tasks (libs/core/customer-decision/operator-handoff.ts). Its grant is the inbox and the shared lock directory; the tier guard narrows every write and mkdir to the inbox entries file, its directory and the inbox's own deliverable-inbox-<sha256>.lock files. No other active/shared/runtime/ path, no knowledge, mission, approval or surface state.
